༄༅/ /ni gu chos drug gi don snying gcig bsdus mkhas grub chen po ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /ḍā kki'i ded dpon 'chi med rig

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ni gu chos drug gi don snying gcig bsdus mkhas grub chen po ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ḍā kki'i ded dpon 'chi med rig 'dzin brnyes/ /sa steng 'gro 'dir mkha' 'gro nai gur grags/ /khyab bdag rgyal dbang mchog dang mi gnyis pa'i/ /rnal 'byor dbang mo gang des bdag la skyongs/ /'gran bral grub mchog thang stong rgyal po dang / /thugs sras brgyud 'dzin blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /'jig rten mig gyur 'gyur med bde chen la/ /byang chub bar du 'dud do thugs rjes skyongs/ /rnam 'dren mchog gi gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rang gis yid la yun ring bsgom pa'i don/ /rgyun gyi nyams len snying por gnad dril te/ /skal ldan slob ma'i don du 'dir 'god bya/ ༈ /mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ sna tshogs padma zla ba nyi ma'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa sku mdog dag byed e'i stong ra dang 'brel ba 'dir dkar po/ thabs lam man phal cher sngon po bya/ byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba la ni gu brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs kyis bskor bar mngon sum lta bur bsam nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bsam la/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa dang / sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang zhes sogs tshad med bsgom/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes pa tshar ci mang dang / spro na sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs so zhes pa nas/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so zhes pa'i bar dkyus ma bzhin dang / re 'ga' gdangs dang bcas pas brgyud 'debs kyang bya/

bla ma rin po che bdag gi nad gdon zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib 'dag par mdzad du gsol/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can brgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa 'di tshar gcig gam gsum gang rung du nges par bya/ yang bla ma rin po che bdag la ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ bdag gi dpral bar thim lus kyi sdig sgrib dag bum dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ mgrin pa'i ā dang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las gsang dbang dang sher dbang sngar bzhin/ bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas byang sems rnams 'od du zhus nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag dbang bzhi thob/ sku bzhi'i rtogs pa mngon du byas pa yin snyam du bsam/ de nas rang gi thod pa dud khang gi nang du klad pa rnams ye mi dmigs par chos 'byung gi rnam pa can/ rtsa ba phra ba mgrin par zug pa/ zur gcig smin mtshams dang zur gnyis rna ltag g.yas g.yon gyi gong tsam du bstan pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba stong seng ba de'i nang du rang sems kyi ngo bo a dkar po a'i sgra sgrog bzhin pa gnyis bsam la/ a a zhes brjod pas/ a las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar la dwangs pa byung / chos 'byung gi nang khengs pas kha nas lud/ lus kyis phyi nang thams cad bkrus pas lus kyi bshang gci'i lam dang / ba spu'i bu ga nas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad nag bun bun thon 'gro bar bsam la a brgya stong la sogs pa bzla/ mthar a nyid kyang bdud rtsir zhu ste lus kyi nang gang bar bsam/ ༈ /rang gi spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang bsgom la/ bla ma rin po che bdag la bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin skye bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag la bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ spro na dbang bzhi blang / de min rang la bstim/

de nas rang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dag ldan par gsal ba'i lus gnad tsog pu la me thab drug chings kyi phyag rgya byas la/ lus kyi nang thams cad rdza gsar pa mes bsregs pa lta bu khog stong de'i lte ba nas bzung / rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar gsal sbom phra sba lcag 'bring po tsam/ g.yas na yar ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon na yar rkyang ma dkar mo gnyis kyang gro sog 'bring po tsam/ rtsa gsum gyis yas sne spyi gtsug tu zug pa'i dbu ma'i yas sner haṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan khams dwangs mas gang ba/ dbu ma'i mas sner nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed kas tsam gyi steng du raṃ las me gla ba'i ril ma tsam dmar ril ba gcig bsgom/ gsum mdo'i gnas su me dang / bshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can yang gsal btab nas rlung ro rnams phyir song ba gcig bus la/ 'og sgo nas gyen du skyod tsam byas pas sum mdo'i me spar ste/ dbu ma'i mas sne'i nyi ma dang me gla ba'i ril ma tsam la thug pas/ me de las me lce phra mo gcig dbu ma'i nang nas yar song / rtse mo snying khar slebs pas de'i drod kyis spyi gtsug gi haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun thig le byung ste/ dbu ma'i nang brgyud snying gi me lce'i rtse mor sor sgra dang bcas te 'bab par bsam/ rlung bum pa can bzung / mi thub na dal bus gtang / gtum mo'i dmigs pa rgyun du 'di tsam gyi chog la/ dgun drang ba'i dus su lus gnad sngar bzhin la/ rje btsun mar gsal ba'i sku lus kyi nang khog stong rdza gsar pa mes bsregs pa ltar/ kha dog dmar la reg bya tsha ba stong sang nge ba de'i lte ba dang / lte ba'i g.yas g.yon mkhal khung gnyis dang / lte ba'i rgyab kyi thad kyi sgal tshigs pa dang bzhir me dmar ril ba che chung bya'i sgo nga tsam drod kyi rang bzhin 'bar la khad pa re sgom la rlung bum can bzung /

rlung ma gtang gi bar la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad/ yang spyi bor pad zla'i steng du bla ma rdo rje 'chang byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba bsgom la/ bla ma rin po che bdag 'dzin blos mthong bar mdzad du gsol/ /dgos med brgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ /sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ bla ma rang la bstims pas rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog dang / rus pa'i rgyan cha drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang / g.yon bskum pa snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku can du gyur/ de la sems cung zad gtad la/ sku mdog phyag mtshan/ rgyan cha lugs rnam pa bzhugs tshul dang ldan pa 'di/ rang gi blos bkod pa ma gtogs/ phyi rol na don la logs su grub pa gcig kyang med/ snang ni snang / bden ni mi bden/ sgyu ma yin snyam du bsam/ de bzhin du phyi rol gyi dgra sdang ba/ mnyen byams pa/ rang phyogs gzhan phyogs ri rdo dang khang pa/ rtsi shing nags tshal dang bcas pa 'di rnams rang gi blos bkod pa ma gtogs/ phyi rol du don logs su grub pa gcig kyang med/ snang ni snang bden ni mi bden rmi lam yin sgyu ma yin snyam du bsam/ yang rang gi lte 'og tu chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas su zug pa/ gdeng kha che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rgya khyon dang ldan pa zhig bsgom/ de'i nang du 'og tu dmyal ba nas bzung rigs drug gi sems can thams cad mas rim bzhin du gnas pa rang rang gi bde sdug gi snang ba sna tshogs la longs spyad pa'i rdzi bir bir ba gcig bsam la/ a 'di thams cad snang ni snang / bden ni mi bden/ rmi lam yin/ sgyu ma yin snyam du bsam/ sgyu ma'i dmigs pa rgyun du 'di tsam gyis chog skabs su rang la gnod pa byed pa'i gdon rnams bkug la/

'og nas rlung rtsa 'then tsam byas pas/ rlung dang sdongs nas chos 'byung gi nang du bcug nas sgyu mar bsgom pas/ gnod byed de'i gdug rtsub dang de'i sdig sgrib zhi nas bden med du cham song bar bsam/ yang rlung dang sdongs nas phyir bton la/ gtor ma'am 'chang bu gcig sbyin la bu lon khyer lan chags byang bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab la phyi'i rgya mtsho'i mthar song bar bsam/ ༈ /yang 'di ltar bsam ste/ sngar skyes zin pa'i sems can la ma shi ba gcig kyang med/ ma 'ongs pa na skyes pa thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ da lta skyes nas sa steng na gnas pa thams cad kyang nges par 'chi bas bdag kyang myur du 'chi/ gang gis kyang dgos pa med ci byed snyam dang / rang las rgan pa dang gzhon pa na zla khyim mtshes/ rgyal khams kyi mi thams cad shi nas med par 'gro ba yin/ tshe 'di'i bya bas ci byed don mi 'dug chos rnam dag gcig bya'o snyam pa snying gi dkyil du bsgom la/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'od dpag med sku dog dmar po/ phyag g.yas padma dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba gcig bsgom la khyed shes khyed mkhyen snyam pa dang / bla ma rin po che bdag 'dzin blos thong bar mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam zin par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab bla ma rang la bstim/ rang bde mchog lhan skyes sngar bzhin du gyur pa'i spyi bor nas thig le dkar po sran ma tsam gcig byung / dbu ma'i nang brgyud snying khar slebs gsang gnas nas yar thig le dmar po gcig byung / snying khar slebs der thig le gnyis po g.yas phyogs su khra 'khor ba 'gros 'ded kyi 'khor ba la sems gtad/ 'di rmi lam yin/ sgyu ma yin snyam pa dang / mthar de gnyis gcig tu 'dres te 'khor bas je phra je phra la rang yal du song bar bsam la 'dzin med du bzhag

nyin mo yang rgyun gyi chag med du bsgom/ khyad par tho rangs gnyid sad mtshams la bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab cing / 'di bsgom la gnyid thun chung ngu re log la/ yang sad pa na sngar bzhin bsgom la gnyid phran bu khug de ltar yang yang byas pas rmi lam zin no/ /de nas rang rang gi gnas khang dang grogs po kun kyang rmi lam yin/ sgyu ma yin snyam pa dang / nga gnyid du song / rmi lam la gang sbyangs sbyangs yin bsam pas yid kyis rang gi lus de mkhar gyi rtser phyin la g.yang la chad de ltung la bar snang la yal song bar bsgom/ 'di rmi lam yin snyam du bsam/ yang snang ba 'di rmi lam gyi snang bar 'dug lus 'di yid lus kyi lus su 'dug rmi lam dang yid lus la gang sbyangs sbyangs yin/ bden par grub pa med snyam du bsam la/ gyang dang ri la sogs la lus 'di phar thal tshur thal du sbyang / yang snang ba 'di rmi lam du 'dug rmi lam ji ltar spel spel dang / gang sprul sprul yin snyam du bsam la/ rang gi gnas khang de'am/ mdun du snang ba'i dngos po gang mthong ba de gcig la bcu/ bcu la brgya la sogs pa spel ba la 'di rmi lam yin snyam du bsgom/ de bzhin du byi ba 'dul ba la rang byi la dang / byi'u la khra/ khyi la spyang ki/ spyang ki la stag stag la seng ge mi 'dul ba la srin po la sogs par blos sprul zhing spel nas 'ded pa dang / za ba la sogs pa byed cing 'di rmi lam yin snyam du bsam/ de bzhin du klu 'dul ba la khyung / rgyal po 'dul ba la rta mgrin/ klu bdud dang klu srin la spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra/ srin po dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa la rang phyag na rdo rje la sogs par blos sprul zhing / spel nas phyag mtshan gyis lus dum bur btub cing tshar bcad pas/ kho'i srog sngags phul bar bsam la gdul bya 'dul byed thams cad sems snang rmi lam gyi rol rtsed du 'dug snyam du bsgom/ sbyang spel 'di rnams ni gdan thog gcig tu thun gyi nyams len la 'chag med dang /

'gro 'chag bza' btung la sogs pa'i gnas skabs kun tu yang dran pa'i rtsis zin par byas la yang yang bsgom/ gnyid dus rmi lam zin pa na las dang po pas de ma thag sbyong spel gyi rtsab rtsob mi bya bar/ a 'di rmi lam du 'dug chos thams cad 'di dang 'dra/ rmi lam gyi snang ba las bden par ma grub pas bde sdug dang chags sdang byed pa rang 'khrul pa yin snyam pa dang / de'i ngang nas sad 'byams dang 'khrul 'byams du ma shor na/ rang gang nyams len byed pa'i yi dam gyi lha'i sku gcig tu gsal lam gyi bsgom la/ zhal phyag rnams gsal e thebs lta/ rmi lam du rang lhar bsgom thub na bar dor lha skur 'tshang rgya ba'i sa ni gu mas sgyu ma lam rim las/ rmi lam zin nas lha yi sku/ /rang shar yud tsam byung gyur na/ /bar do zin pa the tshom med/ /ces gsungs so// bon thebs pa yin pas 'di phan yon che bar bshad/ rmi lam rgyun du yang yang zin cing cung zad brtan par gyur na nyin mo bsgom pa'am rmi lam sbyongs spel la sogs pa rmi lam zin pa'i dus der yang bya zhing / yul snang blta ba yang ji ltar 'tshams pa bya'o/ /rmi lam zin nas gnyid sad pa dang / sngar gyi rmi lam gyi snang ba dang sad pa'i snang ba gnyis khyad par mi 'dug gnyis ka rang gi sems snang yin par ni mtshungs/ rmi lam gyi snang ba ni rgyu gnyid kyis bslad pa'i bag chags 'khrul pa yin/ sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi snang ba ni/ rgyu thog ma med pa'i bag chags kyis bslad pa'i sems nyid gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa yin/ 'bras bu yang gnyis kas chags sdang bde sdug bskyed pa'i don byed nus par mtshungs pas khyad par ci yang mi 'dug snyam du da ltar gyi snang ba thams cad dang bsres nas bzhag ni gu mas gnyid log sad par gyur pa des/ sngar gyi rmi lam zin pa dang / sad pa'i 'khrul snang khyad med bsgom/ zhes gsungs/ ༈ /bzhi pa 'od gsal ni sngar gyi sbyong spel gyi rjes de ma thag rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje 'chang sngar bzhin bsgom la/

skyabs gnas thams cad bstim/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa byin rlabs kyi bdag nyid yin snyam du bsam nas/ bstod pa dang gsol 'debs ci nus dang bla ma rin po che bdag 'dzin blos mthong bar mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal 'byong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la dbang bzhi blang pa'am/ yang na rang la bstim pa tsam bya/ rang bde mchog lhan skyes sngar bzhin du gsal ba'i gsang gnas nas bzung / tshangs bug gi bar du rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar gsal sbub stong phru ma phus btab pa lta bur gsal btab/ lte 'og sor bzhir dbu ma'i nang du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo a dkar la 'tsher ba/ gsal la dwangs pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can gcig bsam la/ a'i rang bzhin skye med du shes par byas la/ gsal stong 'dzin med du mnyam par bzhag yang rang gi klad rgya dang thod pa'i bar du bdag med ma dkar mo gri gug dang / thod pa 'dzin pa chung ngu zhig gi thugs khar a dkar po de las 'od 'phros klad pa thams cad mi dmigs par gtsang sing ste sbyangs/ thod pa dud khang gi gzhal yas khang 'od kyi rang bzhin kha dog dkar po skya ldem me ba la sems gtad/ yang rang bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba'i thugs kar bla ma rdo rje 'chang rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa dngul chu dwangs pa'i mdog can thig le'i ngo bo yin pa la bde ba'i rang bzhin can/ de'i thugs kar hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od 'phros pas bla ma'i sku gsal sing nge byas/ bla ma las 'od 'phros pas rang nyid yi dam gyi skur gnas pa gsal sing ste byas par bsam la dmigs pa gtad/ rgyun du 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa gsum char thub na rab/ 'bring na thog mtha' gnyis sam/ yang na a la sems bzung ba'i dmigs pa des chog/ ༈ /'pho ba ni rang lhan skyes su gsal ba'i spyi bor seng ges stegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la/

bla ma rdo rje 'chang sngar bzhin bsgom la khyed shes khyed mkhyen snyam pa dang / rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad kyang mchod pa'i sprin tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par blos sprul nas phul bar bsam/ bla ma rin po che bdag 'dzin blos thong bar mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ lam mchog 'pho ba 'byong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ rang gi snying gi dbus su rang gi sems nyid a dkar po gcig tu bsam la/ yar bla ma la mos gus byas pas spyi gtsug gi bu kha brgya mthong kha phye ba ltar bsam la/ rigs kyi bu yar la shog gsung ba'i snang ba byung bas rang sems a de dbu ma'i nang nas yar bya phur ba bzhin song nas bla ma'i thugs khar thim/ bla ma dang rang sems 'dres pa'i nam zhig las la sbyar ba na rang sems bla ma'i thugs kar thim ma thag bla ma mkha' dbyings mthon por yud tsam gyis byon nas 'og min du slebs so snyam pa dang / rang sems brjod bral gyi ngang du 'jog pa yin gsungs/ da lta rgyun du 'di mi dgos/ ngang la 'dzin med du cham mer bzhag slar rang sems a de thugs kha nas thon spyi gtsug nas mar dbu ma'i nang rgyud/ rang gi snying khar slebs spyi gtsug gi bu ga chu shu'i kha tshang bzhin bkag ste sra zhing brtan par bsam zhing spyi bo'i bla ma rang la bstim pa'am/ mi dmigs pa gang bde bya// ༈ /bar do'i nyams len ni/ yang rang gi spyi bor bla ma sngar bzhin bsgom la/ bdag 'dzin blos mthong bar mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ bar do rgyal ba longs skur 'tshang rgya bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ bla ma rang la bstim/ a nga shi 'dug nga'i lus 'di bar do'i yid lus su 'dug zas gos gnas khang la sogs pa 'di thams cad bar do'i snang bar 'dug snyam pa dang / snang ba thams cad bden med sgyu ma rmi lam yin snyam du bsgom/ rang gi mdun du chos 'byung mthing nag gru gsum gyi nang du rang sems hūm̐ du bsgom/

de las 'od kha dog lnga 'phros pas 'das ma 'ongs da ltar dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i skye gnas bzhi las tshogs dang dri ma sbyangs/ hūm̐ de yongs su gyur pa las rang bde mchog yab yum dang chags sdang gi yul pho mor snang ba thams cad kyang / bde mchog dang rdo rje phag mo'i skur gyur/ sgra thams cad sngags kyi sgra dang / dran rtog thams cad gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du dar gcig bzhag bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs ci shes bya/ de ltar chos drug la chig sgril byas te dran 'dun drag pos nyams su blangs na rab tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ste 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar 'gyur ro/ /brjed ngas le lo'i dbang du ma btang bar/ /dad dang nges 'byung drag pos brgyud bskul nas/ /nyams len 'di la snying nas 'bungs gyur na/ /skye ba gtan gyi don chen 'grub pa gda'/ /ces pa 'di ni rje bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis/ dbon po padma gar gyi dbang phyug gis nan du bskul ba'i ngor/ grub chen gyis khrid yig snying po kun 'dus kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ lcags pho sprel lor mang mkhar dgon gsar gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o/ /'dis kyang rang gzhan gyi 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs te bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub cing bkra shis par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 ngag dbang chos grags/ ni gu chos drug gi don snying gcig bsdus/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
